تستبدون (form X)
# تَسْتَبِدُّونَ (tastabiddūna) /tas.ta.bid.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبَدَّ (istabadda)
# تُسْتَبَدُّونَ (tustabaddūna) /tus.ta.bad.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَبَدَّ (istabadda)
